hero.title: Executive MBA in Sweden for Indian Students
paras: An **Executive Master of Business Administration (Executive MBA or EMBA) in Sweden** is designed for experienced professionals, managers, entrepreneurs, and business leaders who want to strengthen their leadership abilities, strategic thinking, and business decision-making skills while continuing their careers.

overview: Swedish business schools offer executive education programmes covering **general management, corporate finance, innovation, organisational leadership, and international business**. Many programmes follow a part-time format, allowing participants to balance professional responsibilities with postgraduate education.

One of the prominent options is the **Stockholm School of Economics Executive MBA**, an 18-month, part-time programme taught in English. For the December 2026 intake, the published tuition fee is SEK 645,000, excluding applicable VAT.

For Indian professionals considering an **Executive MBA in Sweden**, it is important to compare programme duration, teaching language, admission requirements, fees, and travel arrangements before applying.
Through **Edu Hawk worldwide** study abroad guidance, students can explore language-learning options and understand the eligibility, fees and application requirements.

universities.name: \. Stockholm School of Economics
universities.desc: * **Programme:** SSE MBA Executive Format * **Duration:** 18 months * **Study Mode:** Part-time * **Language:** English * **Start Date Listed:** December 2026 * **Tuition Fee:** SEK 645,000 (before applicable VAT) * **Approximate Tuition Fee:** ₹61.28 lakh (before VAT) ![][image1] The programme focuses on general management and leadership development for experienced professionals. It also includes additional certificate opportunities alongside the MBA degree. Applicants should review the official programme information for admission requirements, application dates, and applicable tax conditions.

universities.name: \. University of Gothenburg
universities.desc: * **Programme:** Gothenburg Executive MBA * **Duration:** 21 months * **Study Mode:** Part-time * **Tuition Fee for the 2026–2028 Programme:** SEK 545,000 (excluding VAT) * **Approximate Tuition Fee:** ₹51.78 lakh (before VAT) ![][image2] The programme is designed for managers working in private and public organisations. It incorporates practical learning and international study modules. Applicants should contact the provider to confirm the current intake, teaching language, schedule, and admission arrangements.

universities.name: \. Stockholm University
universities.desc: * **Programme:** Executive MBA * **Duration:** 21 months * **Study Mode:** Part-time executive learning * **Programme Fee:** SEK 489,000 (excluding VAT) * **Approximate Tuition Fee:** ₹46.46 lakh (before VAT) ![][image3] The programme leads to the award of a **Master of Science in Business Administration**. It is taught mainly in Swedish, with some English-language elements. According to the programme information provided, the fee is paid by the employer or organisation rather than the individual participant. Applicants should confirm the current sponsorship and payment conditions directly with the institution. **Important:** Executive MBA programmes are different from standard full-time MBA or MSc degrees. They are generally designed for professionals with substantial work experience and may have different admission criteria, teaching languages, fee-payment arrangements, and immigration considerations.

items.q: Can Indian students apply for Executive MBA in Sweden?
items.a: Yes, Indian students with qualifying credentials meeting English language proficiency (IELTS/TOEFL) and academic prerequisites can apply to recognized universities in Sweden.

items.q: What is the medium of instruction for Executive MBA in Sweden?
items.a: Most master's and international bachelor's degree programmes are taught entirely in English for international students across Swedish universities.

items.q: What are the typical tuition fees for Executive MBA in Sweden?
items.a: Tuition fees for international students generally range between SEK 80,000 and SEK 150,000 per year, depending on the institution and level of study.

items.q: Can international students work while studying in Sweden?
items.a: Yes, non-EU international students holding a valid Swedish residence permit for higher education are permitted to work alongside their studies without a fixed hours limitation during term time.
